title: Durable COA & Laboratory Measurement Record
description: Durable archive-facing representation of one laboratory report (COA): the report document, its batch/lot/package, and every analyte measurement with full censoring, unit, method, and comparability metadata. Result states (numeric, nd, below_lod, below_loq, zero, missing, not_tested, invalid) are distinct and are never collapsed or silently imputed as zero. Reported values are preserved verbatim (reported_value/reported_unit); value/unit carry the normalized representation with an audited conversion. Batch identity (batch_id) and report identity (report_id, lab-results/TLAB-XXXX) are distinct: one batch may have retests, corrected reports, multiple panels, or reports from different laboratories. Cultivar claims (cultivar_claims) carry the printed label plus an explicit resolution grade; provenance ties the report to its source document/endpoint. See docs/coa-data-model.md, docs/graph/coa-lab-data-model.md and docs/graph/coa-migration.md.

report_id.description: Archive record id for the laboratory report (COA). Verified records require the canonical form lab-results/TLAB-XXXX (enforced conditionally on batch.record_kind); provisional natural keys (e.g. ma-ccc:<metrc tag>) are tolerated only for non-verified records.

revision.description: Report revision; increments when a corrected report supersedes an earlier one.

supersedes.description: report_id of the prior revision this report supersedes, or null.

source_reference.description: Reference to the original artifact: COA number, PDF id, or dataset row key, so every value traces to the printed document.

test_date.description: Date the sample was tested (may differ from report_date).

sample_date.description: Date the sample was collected/received, when the report states it.

sample_id.description: The laboratory's own sample identifier as printed, when provided.

jurisdiction.description: Regulatory jurisdiction of the report, e.g. CA, MA. Enables jurisdiction-stratified analysis.

license_references.description: Regulator license references: canonical licenses/TLIC-XXXX ids when archive records exist, else natural license numbers as printed.

test_panels.description: Panels the report covers, e.g. cannabinoid, terpene, pesticide, heavy-metal, microbial, mycotoxin, residual-solvent. Unknown panels are preserved verbatim.

provenance.description: Retrieval metadata tying the report to its source document/endpoint. Verified records require at least one of source_url / document_hash / upstream_record_id.

lab_id.description: Canonical testing-laboratories/TSTL-XXXX archive id when the laboratory has a record, else null.

license_number.description: Regulator license number as printed, when public.

batch_id.description: Producer/operator batch identifier (natural key as printed). Stable across retests and reports.

metrc_tag.description: State traceability package tag (e.g. Metrc METRC SOURCE TAG) when the source system provides one.

lot_number.description: Producer lot number as printed, when distinct from batch_id.

producer_id.description: Canonical producer organization id, e.g. organizations/TORG-XXXX, or null when unknown. Must be actual JSON null, never the string "null".

product_id.description: Canonical commercial product id, e.g. products/TPRD-XXXX, or null when unknown.

cultivar_labels.description: Cultivar labels exactly as printed; never collapsed or canonicalized at ingest.

cultivar_claims.description: Interpreted cultivar claims for this batch: printed label plus resolution grade and optional canonical cultivars/TCUL-XXXX target. May be empty; resolution is never forced.

matrix_detail.description: Sub-matrix as printed, e.g. "Raw Plant Material", "Buds", "Distillate".

basis.description: Reporting basis. Cross-batch comparison requires explicit basis normalization; never implicit.

decarb_convention.description: native = acids and neutrals reported separately; total-potential = acid converted (e.g., THCA x 0.877 + THC). Mandatory context for cannabinoid profiles.

record_kind.description: verified = real provenance-verified COA; demonstration = sample/placeholder record excluded from derived statistics; unverified = real-looking but unverified record, also excluded. Derived statistics use only record_kind == verified.

production_date.description: Production date as printed, when the source provides one; optional and never required.

package_date.description: Package date as printed, when the source provides one; optional and never required.

compound_id.description: Canonical compound entity id when a record exists (e.g. cannabinoids/TCBN-0007 for THCA, contaminants/TCNT-0007 for Lead); null when unmapped. Identity is keyed on the entity id, never the display name.

compound_name.description: Analyte name as parsed from the report, for readability and identity when compound_id is null.

compound_cas.description: CAS registry number when known and verified.

reported_value.description: Exact result string as printed (e.g. "0.0", "1.34", "ND", "<0.05"). Preserved verbatim; never rounded.

state.description: numeric = fully quantified; nd = not detected; below_lod / below_loq = censored below a limit; zero = explicit zero as printed (flagged for review, never conflated with nd or missing); missing = blank result field; not_tested = absent from the panel; invalid = result string present but unparseable (preserved verbatim, never conflated with nd or zero).

value.description: Normalized numeric value. Required for numeric and zero states; must be null otherwise.

unit.description: Canonical unit of the normalized value. A batch may contain multiple units (e.g. % w/w cannabinoids, mg/g terpenes, ppm pesticides); measurements are only compared/composed after explicit normalization into a compatible analyte subset.

lod.description: Method limit of detection in the same unit. Required when state == below_lod.

loq.description: Method limit of quantitation in the same unit. Required when state == below_loq.

method.description: Per-measurement method override; when null the report-level method applies.

conversion.description: Audit trail for converting reported_value/reported_unit into value/unit. Null when no conversion was applied.

calculation_formula.description: When set, this measurement is a report-derived calculated quantity (e.g. Total THC = d9-THC + THCA x 0.877) and the formula is retained verbatim. Calculated quantities are not independent chemical compounds and should not carry a compound_id.

methodMetadata.description: Minimum-viable-comparability method metadata (laboratory-comparability report §3). Unknowns are explicit; omitting the object means the report carries no method section and cannot grade above D.

derivatization.description: For GC cannabinoids: were acidic forms derivatized? Underivatized GC underestimates acidic cannabinoids.

moisture_content_pct.description: Moisture content in percent (0-100); needed for dry-weight <-> as-received conversion.

measurement_uncertainty.description: Expanded uncertainty (k=2) as a relative fraction, e.g. 0.10 = ±10%.

pt_z_score.description: Most recent proficiency-testing z-score for this analyte; |z| >= 3 is unsatisfactory (ISO 13528).

label.description: Cultivar label exactly as printed (e.g. "Blue Dream", "GG4", "GMO"). Never canonicalized.

resolution.description: resolved = confidently one cultivar; tentative = leaning toward one; ambiguous = matches several possibilities; unresolved = no canonical target. Resolution is never forced.

cultivar_id.description: Canonical cultivars/TCUL-XXXX id when the claim resolves (resolved requires it); null otherwise.

candidate_ids.description: The several canonical possibilities when the label is ambiguous.

sourceProvenance.description: Retrieval metadata tying a report to its source document/endpoint. Verified records require at least one of source_url / document_hash / upstream_record_id.

document_hash.description: sha256 hex digest of the source artifact when computed.

upstream_record_id.description: Upstream record id (dataset row key, COA number, portal id) as printed by the source.

parser_version.description: Parser/import version that produced this record, for reprocessing audits.

added_uncertainty.description: Relative uncertainty (fraction) contributed by conversion parameters, for propagation by the analysis engine.
